headline: S&P Affirms Poland's Foreign Currency Rating at 'A-', Lowers Outlook to Negative
summary: S&P Global Ratings affirmed Poland's foreign currency credit rating at 'A-' while revising the outlook from stable to negative, signaling potential downgrade risks ahead.
why: Sovereign credit rating and outlook changes influence government borrowing costs and international investor demand for domestic bonds.

impacts.name: Poland
impacts.why: A negative outlook revision signals increased risk of a future sovereign credit rating downgrade.
